in_short: This is the page behind "See a sample grade first". Until the visitor clicks the button it showed 47 words, and it never said what the check actually looks at.
Google Analytics was not on it. You could not see how many owners opened the sample grade, or how many clicked "Book a free check", which is the one contact route on the site that works today.
15 changes are on the branch: 9 technical, 3 text, 3 tracking.
The page looks the same down to the note under the button. One short section is new below it.

needs_you_intro: Nothing on this page needs you. One observation, because it touches the critical item from the homepage.

needs_you.title: "Book a free check" is the only contact route that reaches you
needs_you.detail: The button on this page opens an email to rihla.enquiries@gmail.com. The two forms on the homepage still save their entries in the visitor's browser and nowhere else. So today an owner who reads this page and emails you is a lead you receive, and an owner who fills in Claim your spot is one you never see.
needs_you.action: Nothing to do on this page. It is one more reason to fix the homepage forms first. From today GA4 counts clicks on this button as `grader_book_check`.

changes.title: Share tags
changes.why: The page had no Open Graph or X tags. A shared link now shows the title, the description and the 1200 × 630 Rihla card.
changes.after: og:type, og:site_name, og:locale, og:title, og:description, og:url, og:image (+ size and alt), twitter:card = summary_large_image

changes.title: Structured data
changes.why: Added WebSite, WebPage and a breadcrumb (Rihla, then Halal Visibility Check sample). Demo Diner is fictional, so it is deliberately not described as a restaurant, and the grade is not marked up as a rating.

changes.title: Sample grade kept out of search results
changes.why: The grade C, "Certificate visible online: Not found" and "18 in the last 90 days" are all invented. The card sits in the page's HTML even while hidden, and Google could have quoted it under a Rihla link. It now carries `data-nosnippet`. This follows your own rule from the email README: never show Demo Diner sample data as a real grade.

changes.title: Missing spaces in the five result rows
changes.why: The label and its result had no space between them in the HTML. Anything reading plain text saw "Google listing✓ Found" and "Certificate visible online✗ Not found".

changes.title: Icons and language, as on the homepage
changes.why: Added the `favicon.ico` fallback, the iPhone icon and `theme-color`, set `lang="en-US"`, and marked the Arabic letter in the top bar as Arabic.

changes.title: Same font request as the homepage
changes.why: The page now sends the identical request, so a visitor arriving from the homepage already has it cached. No bytes saved on a first visit.

changes.title: Taller tap areas
changes.why: "Back to Rihla" in the top bar was 18 px tall and the footer links 17 px. They are now 42 px and 29 px to tap. Nothing moved. The top bar also stopped growing when the Arabic font arrives, which is why the layout shift is now 0.

changes.title: Shared script
changes.why: The page now loads `site.js`, the shared file introduced with the demo report page. It saves the first campaign, reports clicks and shows the cookie notice.

changes.title: Sitemap date
changes.why: The entry for this page in `sitemap.xml` now says it changed today.

changes.title: Title
changes.why: The old title ended in "demo", which says nothing about what the visitor gets. The new one says it: a sample grade.
changes.after: Halal Visibility Check: see a sample grade — Rihla

changes.title: Meta description
changes.why: It now leads with the question the check answers, in the homepage's own words, and says what the visitor will see. "Sample data only" stays in.
changes.before: Demo of the Rihla Halal Visibility Check. Sample data only, no real restaurant was graded.
changes.after: See a sample Halal Visibility Check: can diners and AI tell a restaurant is halal? Five signals, one grade, three fixes. Sample data only.

changes.title: New section: "What the check looks at"
changes.why: Before the button was clicked, the page never said what is checked. A short list now does, between the note and the sample card. The five items are word for word the five rows of the card. The closing sentence is the homepage's promise: checked by hand, a call with your grade and three fixes. A link to the monthly report demo closes the page, so the two demos point at each other.

left_alone: **The button that reveals the grade.** It imitates the real flow: type a name, get a grade. Search engines read the hidden card anyway.
**The H1, the badge and the note under the button.** "Demo — sample data only" and "No real restaurant was graded" are exactly what this page needs to say.
**The sample grade and its three fixes.** Unchanged.
**"Book a free check" as an email link.** It works, which the forms do not yet.
**Canonical tag, indexing and sitemap entry.** Correct.
verify_intro: Do these once the branch is merged and Vercel has deployed it.
verify: Open the page in a private window. The cookie notice appears. Click Accept.
In GA4, open Reports, then Realtime. Click "See a sample grade" on the page, then "Book a free check". Two `cta_click` events should appear.
Run the page through [Google's Rich Results Test](https://search.google.com/test/rich-results). It should find the breadcrumb and report no errors.

files.change: Head tags, structured data, Google tag, new section, link, click names

method: Audited from the repository and rendered in headless Chrome at 390 px and 1366 px on a local copy of the site, with the sample grade closed and open. 29 automated checks pass.
The live site is still unreachable from the audit sandbox, so nothing here was checked in production.
Speed and layout-shift figures come from a lab run that imitates a mid-range phone on slow 4G, median of 5 runs. Use them to compare before and after, not as absolute scores.
